name: Auguste Comte
shortBio: French philosopher who coined the term 'sociology' and established positivism; proposed the Law of the Three Stages of intellectual development.
centralQuestion: What immutable scientific laws govern social statics and social dynamics across historical epochs?

keyWorks.title: The Course in Positive Philosophy
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise articulating the positive hierarchy of sciences and sociology.

keyWorks.title: A General View of Positivism
keyWorks.description: Formulates moral reorganization of society around empirical scientific observation.
